text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: 『Dream Fest』――

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It is an all-star race meant to draw 
attention to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... An all-star race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a race full of 
popular faces. I'm sure it'll make waves 
with certain crowds, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to breaking through the 
current situation, would you really call 
that a clever approach?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: That's a sharp insight.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"To revitalize the Twinkle Series once 
more"—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Our objective is exceedingly vague and 
elusive, making results difficult to see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, merely creating a new race 
wouldn't solve this issue."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That everyone raised their voices— the 
excitement of the races, the charm of 
Umamusume themselves...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What is required is the steady effort to 
appeal to the hearts of each and every 
fan."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's where we, the Umamusume 
alumni, come in!"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the appeal of racing, for 
example... I could offer a few suggestions 
of my own.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: "Once more: I am Speed Symboli."

"Speed Symboli... Across a long career, 
she ran in the Arima Kinen five times. A 
tough Umamusume who achieved back-to-back 
victories right before retiring—"

What is particularly noteworthy is that 
she went on a long-term expedition to 
Europe, which was extraordinary for that 
era. She was a pioneer who paved the way 
for racing abroad.
choice_data_list:
(A pioneer who broadened the horizons of 
racing...!)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—To build bridges across the world. That 
is my philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Currently, they oversee the URA's Overseas 
Operations Department. To put it simply...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Kind of like a jack-of-all-trades who 
makes it easier for everyone to go 
overseas.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Wherever you wish to go, I shall pave the 
path. Just wait for me in your stylish 
outfit."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Saying things like an old geezer again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A vigorous spirit that defies age—that 
person seems to overflow with more energy 
with every passing year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The origin of the Symboli family's 
glorious history... It is truly a stroke 
of good fortune to see you again after so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. Like it's really that great.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, not just myself. I have invited 
the most suitable person to convey the 
sheer excitement of racing—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"A pleasure meeting you all." I am St. 
Lite.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh... St Lite, as in *that*... ?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I-It really existed...

It's no wonder they're shocked. St Lite... 
the very first Classic Triple Crown 
Umamusume in history.

Her active career lasted just a single 
year. Leaving behind only an intense 
streak of light before stepping down, she 
remains an enigmatic figure to this day—
choice_data_list:
(It was my first time meeting them, 
too...)
(It's my first time meeting her too...)

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Even after stepping away from the Twinkle 
Series, I have continued to watch over all 
of your journeys.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: —Particularly, the path to the "crown."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I hope that my experience will serve as 
nourishment for you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... How unusual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just once. Even so... yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Burning so fiercely... you shed your veil 
of silence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I see...
(Kyaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fans
text_block_list.text: Ready, and! ――Haiseiko-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for your warm cheers!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, this feels just like a concert! 
Uh, ahem!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I'm Haiseiko. I'm an active idol♪

Haiseiko... The legendary original idol 
Umamusume who took not only the racing 
world, but all of Japan by storm.

Over 100,000 people always flocked to her 
races; she was truly the idol among idols.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like an introduction is hardly 
necessary. To convey the sheer charm of 
Umamusume themselves—"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, wouldn't the one who has 
you all so utterly captivated right now... 
be the most fitting choice?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: What I can do might be very little, but—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone's smiles, I'll 
give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah...! W-W-Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It's really them...! Their face is so 
tiny! S-So cute~~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I've seen it on TV before too. So that's 
what a celebrity is..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if I could get an autograph 
later.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
We pool together our experiences and 
insights... and pass them down to the next 
generation.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
You all grow, hone your individuality... 
and deliver ever more magnificent races.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that! To draw the public's 
attention, we're going to hold the 'Dream 
Fest'!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
An All-Star race... If girls from every 
generation run, it should catch the 
attention of people of all ages, don't you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To return to those days... when the 
Twinkle Series was filled with such 
tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: No! To see a view beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I need the strength of all of you— of 
every single Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Let us deliver that burning 
passion once more! —We shall hold a 
festival of dreams!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Awesome...! I get to be coached by 
people like them?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Can I hear about... your overseas 
experiences?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...*Gasp*, what should I do... My heart is 
aching so... Hehehe...

"An all-star race open to all 
generations... Meaning even <chrname>, who is in 
the Junior Class, might be able to 
participate!"

That experience will surely benefit <chrname>. 
Thinking so, I go to consult Speed Symboli 
just to be sure, and—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Continue to hone your skills until that 
day arrives. We shall lend our strength as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be so nervous. We're teammates, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ah, it was you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Unable to sit still given the current 
situation, the Trainer rushed into Yayoi's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I see. ...You have a good Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing will change if you merely wait. 
Unless you take action... the era and the 
world will remain the exact same scenery."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...That said, I am not as pessimistic as I 
made myself out to be when firing everyone 
up.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then, your trainee Umamusume is making 
her debut soon, correct?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If she continues to make her presence 
known from here on... there will surely 
come a time when we can borrow her 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Having a popular and talented Umamusume 
handle PR is like having the strength of a 
hundred people.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Besides, as for you... this is just a 
hunch, but I'm sure there will be times 
when I'll rely on you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, please lend me your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Together, for the sake of the Umamusume— 
let us give it our all!

I squeeze the outstretched hand in return, 
renewing my resolve.

Liven up the Twinkle Series... That will 
surely lead directly to <chrname>'s future.

After thinking it over... I decided to 
create a social media account to promote 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Social Media
text_block_list.text: "I am <username>, Trainer in charge of <chrname>!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Social Media
text_block_list.text:
"Starting today, I want to once again 
share the charm of Umamusume racing! 
Please help spread the word!"
